notes: Read all 185 source lines line by line before editing. useTour drives a guided multi-step onboarding tour: it owns isActive/currentStep navigation (start/next/prev/skip/finish), fires per-step onShow/onHide callbacks, persists per-tour completion, and on the WEB ONLY measures the highlighted DOM element (DOMRect via document.querySelector + getBoundingClientRect, kept fresh by ResizeObserver + window resize/scroll) so a spotlight overlay can be positioned. The navigation + callback + persistence core ports 1:1 and is genuinely useful on native; only the DOM spotlight measurement is structurally browser-only and is degraded with an explicit unavailable state (contract rules 4,5,7).

L1 `import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'` -> `import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'` (reordered; all four kept and used: useState backs isActive+currentStep, useCallback backs start/next/prev/skip/finish, useEffect backs the onShow/onHide effect, useRef backs stepsRef+persistRef).

L2-6 `import { markTourCompleted as markCompletedInRegistry, markTourSkipped as markSkippedInRegistry, resetAllTours as resetAllInRegistry } from '@/lib/tourRegistry'` REPLACED by inlined native-safe shims of the same names. tourRegistry is a browser-only window.localStorage module with no native parity port (and porting it is out of scope: it cyclically imports useTour itself plus eight @/features/onboarding/tours/* definitions). The three writers this hook actually calls are reproduced verbatim in semantics: module-scoped `const tourCompletionStore = new Map<string,string>()` (the useNotificationListener/confirmSilence/draftIndex in-memory-Map localStorage precedent), `tourStorageKey(id,version) => `teslasync:tour:v${version}:${id}`` (exact web key schema from tourRegistry L65-70), markCompletedInRegistry sets 'completed', markSkippedInRegistry sets 'skipped', resetAllInRegistry deletes every `teslasync:tour:` key + the legacy `teslasync-tour-completed` flag (mirroring tourRegistry resetAllTours L129-146). Local names kept identical so the in-hook call sites stay byte-identical. Cold-restart persistence is the only behavioural loss.

L7 `import { broadcast } from '@/lib/broadcast'` REPLACED by an inlined native-safe `broadcast` no-op. broadcast.ts is the browser BroadcastChannel/localStorage cross-tab bus; React Native is a single process with no peer tab (the useChartPalette parity note already records 'no BroadcastChannel on native'), and the web bus never echoes to the same tab, so a cross-tab broadcast is a genuine no-op. A local `TourBroadcastMessage` union models the exact subset this hook emits (`tour.completed` {tourId,version} and `tour.reset` {tourId?}) from broadcast.ts BroadcastMessage L56-57, so the call-site payloads stay byte-identical and typed.

L9-22 `export interface TourStep` ported verbatim — target, title, description, placement ('top'|'bottom'|'left'|'right'), optional onShow/onHide. Only the `target` doc is adapted: on web it is a CSS selector resolved via document.querySelector; on native it is an opaque key a tour-overlay host maps to a measured View (e.g. via onLayout). All field names/types preserved.

L24-35 `interface TourState` ported with field names preserved verbatim (isActive, currentStep, totalSteps, step, targetRect, start, next, prev, skip, finish). L29 `targetRect: DOMRect | null` -> `targetRect: TourTargetRect | null` because the native tsconfig ships no `dom` lib (DOMRect type unavailable). Two ADDITIVE contract-rule-7 fields are appended — `targetingStatus: TourTargetingStatus` and `unavailableReason: string | null` — keeping the return a superset so existing destructuring consumers are unaffected. Interface kept non-exported exactly like the web.

L29 DOMRect modelled by the new exported `TourTargetRect` interface (x,y,width,height,top,right,bottom,left — DOMRect's readable fields) so a native overlay host that measures a target View can supply the same shape; the hook itself reports null because there is no getBoundingClientRect source on native. Added `export type TourTargetingStatus = 'unavailable'` and `export const TOUR_TARGETING_UNAVAILABLE_REASON` (the useTitleBadge/useWebPush/useNotificationListener explicit-unavailable precedent) documenting the dropped DOM measurement.

L37-45 the TourPersistenceContext JSDoc (writes per-tour completion into tourRegistry; no-ops without it; the legacy single global flag is no longer written — call resetAllTours once to clear it) preserved verbatim. L46-51 `export interface TourPersistenceContext { id: string; version: number }` ported verbatim with both per-field doc comments.

L53-56 `export function useTour(steps: TourStep[], persistence?: TourPersistenceContext): TourState` signature preserved verbatim. L57 `const [isActive, setIsActive] = useState(false)` and L58 `const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(0)` preserved verbatim (state names intact).

L59 `const [targetRect, setTargetRect] = useState<DOMRect | null>(null)` -> `const targetRect: TourTargetRect | null = null` with an explanatory comment: the web rect was state fed by getBoundingClientRect through a ResizeObserver + window scroll/resize listeners, none of which exist on native, so the rect has no source and is permanently null (avoids an unused setter while keeping the `targetRect` name in the return). L60 `const observerRef = useRef<ResizeObserver | null>(null)` DROPPED — ResizeObserver is browser-only and the native tsconfig lacks its type.
L61-62 `const stepsRef = useRef(steps); stepsRef.current = steps;` preserved verbatim (keeps the latest steps out of the useCallback/useEffect dependency closures, exactly as the web does).

L64-75 the `updateRect` useCallback DROPPED: its body is entirely `document.querySelector(stepsRef.current[currentStep].target)` + `el.getBoundingClientRect()` -> setTargetRect, all browser-only with no native source. Its effect is replaced by the permanently-null targetRect + the explicit targetingStatus/unavailableReason. L77-95 the resize/scroll/ResizeObserver useEffect DROPPED for the same reason (window.addEventListener('resize'|'scroll'), `new ResizeObserver(updateRect)`, and their removeEventListener/disconnect cleanup are all browser-only). Both are documented in the file header and TOUR_TARGETING_UNAVAILABLE_REASON.

L97-103 the onShow/onHide useEffect ported 1:1 (pure React logic, no DOM): `if (!isActive || currentStep >= stepsRef.current.length) return; const step = stepsRef.current[currentStep]; step.onShow?.(); return () => { step.onHide?.(); };` with deps `[isActive, currentStep]` preserved verbatim (stepsRef is a ref, exempt from exhaustive-deps).

L105-108 `start = useCallback(() => { setCurrentStep(0); setIsActive(true); }, [])` preserved verbatim. L110-111 `const persistRef = useRef(persistence); persistRef.current = persistence;` preserved verbatim.

L113-124 `next` useCallback ported faithfully: `if (currentStep < stepsRef.current.length - 1) { setCurrentStep(prev => prev + 1) } else { setIsActive(false); const ctx = persistRef.current; if (ctx) { markCompletedInRegistry(ctx.id, ctx.version); broadcast({ type: 'tour.completed', tourId: ctx.id, version: ctx.version }) } }` with deps `[currentStep]`. The ONLY change is renaming the state-updater arrow param `prev` -> `current` (`setCurrentStep(current => current + 1)`) to avoid the @typescript-eslint/no-shadow error against the sibling `prev` useCallback — purely a local rename, behaviour identical. markCompletedInRegistry + broadcast now resolve to the inlined shims.

L126-130 `prev` useCallback: `if (currentStep > 0) { setCurrentStep(prev => prev - 1) }` deps `[currentStep]` — same no-shadow-safe rename of the updater param to `current` (`setCurrentStep(current => current - 1)`); behaviour identical.

L132-139 `skip` useCallback ported verbatim: `setIsActive(false); const ctx = persistRef.current; if (ctx) { markSkippedInRegistry(ctx.id, ctx.version); broadcast({ type: 'tour.completed', tourId: ctx.id, version: ctx.version }) }` deps `[]` (the shim functions are module-scope/stable, persistRef is a ref -> exempt). Note the web fires the 'tour.completed' broadcast on skip too — preserved exactly.

L141-148 `finish` useCallback ported verbatim: `setIsActive(false); const ctx = persistRef.current; if (ctx) { markCompletedInRegistry(ctx.id, ctx.version); broadcast({ type: 'tour.completed', tourId: ctx.id, version: ctx.version }) }` deps `[]`.

L150-161 the return object ported verbatim — isActive, currentStep, `totalSteps: steps.length`, `step: isActive && currentStep < steps.length ? steps[currentStep] : null`, targetRect, start, next, prev, skip, finish — PLUS the two additive fields `targetingStatus: 'unavailable'` and `unavailableReason: TOUR_TARGETING_UNAVAILABLE_REASON`. L162 closing brace preserved.

L164-176 the deprecated `isTourCompleted(): boolean` ported with its @deprecated JSDoc verbatim. L170 `if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false` + L171-175 `try { return window.localStorage.getItem('teslasync-tour-completed') === 'true' } catch { return false }` -> feature-detect localStorage off globalThis: `const ls = (globalThis as {localStorage?: {getItem(key:string):string|null}}).localStorage; if (!ls) return false; try { return ls.getItem('teslasync-tour-completed') === 'true' } catch { return false }`. On bare native localStorage is undefined -> false; on react-native-web it reads the real (never-written) legacy flag -> false. Matches the web doc promise that it 'always returns false now'.

L178-185 the deprecated `resetTour(): void` ported with its @deprecated JSDoc verbatim: `resetAllInRegistry(); broadcast({ type: 'tour.reset' })` — both resolving to the inlined native-safe shims. L185 closing brace preserved.

Native-safe browser-only handling (contract rules 4,5,7): document.querySelector / getBoundingClientRect / DOMRect / ResizeObserver / window resize+scroll listeners (DOM spotlight measurement) are unavailable on native and surfaced via targetRect=null + targetingStatus + TOUR_TARGETING_UNAVAILABLE_REASON; @/lib/tourRegistry localStorage persistence is an in-memory Map shim keeping the exact key schema; @/lib/broadcast cross-tab bus is a typed no-op; legacy localStorage in isTourCompleted is feature-detected off globalThis. No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, react-i18next, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported — only react's useCallback/useEffect/useRef/useState. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit); npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
